problem:
$\,$ $5$ divides $x.$

The predicate $P(x)$ is given above. Which of following represents $¬P(x)?$

examples.knowledge_point: Negating a Predicate Expressed in Plain English
examples.worked_solution:
The symbol "$\neg$" represents negation. So, our task is to negate the given sentence. 

To negate our plain English sentence, we place the words "It is not true that" in front of it. This gives the following:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14099575/assets/c4fcfc8fc10ea5b0cd7ee476d43cee41056e5c398aec7d4b9ca9f10dbc12c5d0.png) 

In other words, $x$ is smaller than $10.$ Therefore, $\neg P(x)$ means the following:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14099575/assets/92d40318f07563c997405d3f0002d479379bbce2cf8b88d7145e40fac1eb867c.png)
